reviews.body:
LGTM, thanks. The archived WOWII entry 373 and definitions 94–95 match the statement: distances are measured in the ambient tree, and only positive pairs enter the average, giving denominator $|B|(|V|-1)$.

I independently reconstructed the pinned certificate’s 150-vertex tree and checked its eleven peripheral vertices, average $29514/1639$, and twelve-vertex total dominating set. Thus $\gamma_t\le12<12+8/1639$, which suffices for the negative answer without proving optimality. The linked proof and exact-statement audit use the same definitions and dependency pins as this PR. I inspected those sources and the author’s reported axiom checks; I did not independently replay the external Lean proof.
